original_prompt: Weathered desert nomad female warrior, wrapped in sun-bleached cloth and bone charms, cracked leather armour, quiet menace in her eyes
prompt: A weathered desert nomad female warrior stands in a neutral frontal pose, arms relaxed at sides, sun-darkened skin with sharp angular features and cold calculating eyes staring directly forward. Layered sun-bleached ivory linen wraps over cracked worn leather armour, stress fractures across the breastplate and pauldrons. Bone charms — carved animal teeth and knuckles strung on sinew — tied into her wrappings and wind-frayed hair. Cracked dry lips, dust settled in skin creases, scarred calloused hands. Vast arid desert behind her, cracked earth, distant rocky mesa silhouettes, sparse blowing sand at ground level.

Carved animal teeth, bones, and knuckles on sinew cord tied into wind-frayed hair and wrappings; weathered leather belt with pouches. Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed at sides, cracked dry lips, dust in skin creases, scarred calloused hands. subject.description: A full body weathered desert nomad female warrior, young or middle-aged, with sun-darkened skin, sharp angular features, and deep-set eyes radiating quiet menace

clothing.value: Layered sun-bleached linen and cotton wraps in faded ivory and dusty tan, draped loosely over cracked, worn leather armour with dried stitching and stress fractures across the breastplate and pauldrons

accessories.value: Bone charms tied into her wrappings and hair — small carved animal bones, teeth, and knuckles strung on sinew cord; a weathered leather belt with pouches

subject.expression_pose: Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed at sides, full body visible head to toe, shoulder to shoulder; expression is cold and watchful with a barely perceptible tension — quiet menace behind steady, calculating eyes, looking straight into the camera

details.value: Cracked dry lips, sun-bleached eyebrows, fine dust settled in the creases of her skin and armour; scarred knuckles and calloused hands; wind-worn cloth edges fraying slightly

setting.value: Open desert environment — vast arid wasteland with cracked earth and distant dune ridges

background.value: Wide open desert horizon with hazy amber sky, distant rocky mesa silhouettes, sparse blowing dust at ground level

props.value: Minimal — scattered bone fragments and small stones at her feet, wind-blown sand drifting across the ground

time_of_day.value: Late afternoon golden hour — harsh desert sun low on the horizon casting long warm shadows and bleaching the sky to a pale amber-orange

camera_angle.value: Eye-level, straight-on frontal view, 85mm lens equivalent — slight distance to capture full figure without distortion

framing.value: Full body head-to-toe shot, figure occupying approximately 65% of frame height, clear empty margin on all four sides, nothing cropped

depth_of_field.value: Moderate depth of field, f/2.8 — subject in sharp focus, background softly blurred to keep attention on the warrior

key_light.value: Strong directional late-afternoon sunlight from the upper right, casting warm golden-orange light across her face and armour, deepening shadows on the left side

fill_rim.value: Soft ambient desert-reflected fill light from below and left in muted warm ochre; faint rim light outlining her silhouette against the hazy sky

mood.value: Harsh, sun-scorched, and isolating — the light feels unforgiving and ancient, reinforcing her solitary menace

art_style.value: Highly detailed fantasy character illustration in the style of Greg Rutkowski and Aleksi Briclot — painterly realism with cinematic quality, textured brushwork emphasizing material wear and grit

quality.value: 8k resolution, highly detailed, professional concept art quality, sharp material textures on leather and cloth, cinematic composition
